question: Should OpenClaw accept `openai/codex-action@52fe01e` in the credentialed agent workflows after confirming its effective privilege and API-key handling?
rationale: The patch updates executable third-party workflow code that receives an OpenAI API key; static PR review can identify the boundary but cannot choose the repository’s acceptable secret-exposure and privilege posture.

options.title: Audit and accept the revision
options.body: Confirm the exact Codex action behavior, permission profile, safety strategy, and job ordering for every credentialed invocation, then merge if they meet the repository’s security policy.

options.title: Hold the Codex action pin
options.body: Merge only the independently reviewed action updates and keep the Codex action at its existing SHA until a dedicated security review approves the upgrade.

options.title: Adopt a stricter workflow profile first
options.body: Update the credentialed Codex workflows to an explicitly reviewed narrow permission profile and safety strategy, then take the dependency revision.
